# Airbyte

> > Airbyte is an open-source data integration platform providing ELT (Extract, Load, Transform) capabilities with 350+ connectors and agent-based data access.

Airbyte offers both a Data Replication Engine for traditional ELT workflows and an Agent Engine for AI-powered data integration. The platform supports OAuth 2.0 authentication, CDC (Change Data Capture), and is built with Python, licensed under MIT.

## Key Topics

- Data Integration & ELT Platform
- Agent Connectors & AI Agents
- Data Replication Engine
- Agent Engine
- OAuth 2.0 Authentication
- Python SDK & API Integration
- Open-Source (MIT License)
- CDC Connectors
- CRM Integration (Salesforce, HubSpot)
- Marketing Platforms (Shopify, Facebook Marketing)
- Project Management (Jira, Linear, Asana)
- Customer Data & Analytics
- Email Marketing (Mailchimp, Klaviyo)
- Issue & Workflow Management

## Getting Started

- [Airbyte | Open-Source Data Integration Platform | ELT Tool](https://airbyte.com): Homepage for Airbyte's open-source data integration and ELT platform
- [Agent Connectors](https://airbyte.com/agent-connectors): Catalog of Airbyte agent connectors for data sources and destinations

## CRM & Sales Connectors

- [Agent Connectors - Salesforce](https://airbyte.com/agent-connectors/salesforce): Salesforce CRM connector for accounts, leads, opportunities, and sales data
- [Agent Connectors - Hubspot](https://airbyte.com/agent-connectors/hubspot): HubSpot CRM connector for contacts, companies, deals, and sales data
- [Agent Connectors - Gong](https://airbyte.com/agent-connectors/gong): Gong connector for revenue intelligence and customer interaction analytics
- [Agent Connectors - Intercom](https://airbyte.com/agent-connectors/intercom): Intercom connector for customer messaging and support analytics

## Marketing & E-commerce Connectors

- [Agent Connectors - Shopify](https://airbyte.com/agent-connectors/shopify): Shopify connector for e-commerce orders, products, and customer data
- [Agent Connectors - Facebook Marketing](https://airbyte.com/agent-connectors/facebook-marketing): Facebook Marketing API connector for ad campaigns and performance data
- [Agent Connectors - Amazon Ads](https://airbyte.com/agent-connectors/amazon-ads): Amazon Ads connector for advertising profiles and campaign management
- [Agent Connectors - Klaviyo](https://airbyte.com/agent-connectors/klaviyo): Klaviyo connector for email marketing and customer engagement analytics
- [Agent Connectors - Mailchimp](https://airbyte.com/agent-connectors/mailchimp): Mailchimp connector for email campaigns and marketing analytics

## Project Management & Development Connectors

- [Agent Connectors - Jira](https://airbyte.com/agent-connectors/jira): Jira connector for issues, projects, and workflow management
- [Agent Connectors - Github](https://airbyte.com/agent-connectors/github): GitHub connector for repositories, issues, PRs, and development analytics
- [Agent Connectors - Linear](https://airbyte.com/agent-connectors/linear): Linear connector for issue tracking and project management
- [Agent Connectors - Asana](https://airbyte.com/agent-connectors/asana): Asana connector for tasks, projects, and productivity insights

## Productivity & Collaboration Connectors

- [Agent Connectors - Slack](https://airbyte.com/agent-connectors/slack): Slack connector for channels, messages, and team communication data
- [Agent Connectors - Google Drive](https://airbyte.com/agent-connectors/google-drive): Google Drive connector for files, shared drives, and permissions
- [Agent Connectors - Airtable](https://airbyte.com/agent-connectors/airtable): Airtable agent connector for accessing bases, tables, and records

## Specialized Connectors

- [Agent Connectors - Greenhouse](https://airbyte.com/agent-connectors/greenhouse): Greenhouse ATS connector for recruiting and talent acquisition analytics
- [Agent Connectors - Orb](https://airbyte.com/agent-connectors/orb): Orb connector for usage-based billing and subscription management
